claims.claim: Executive Order 14233 established the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve on 6 March 2025.
Initial capitalization uses eligible Treasury-held finally forfeited Bitcoin; other agencies review transfer authority.
Reserve Bitcoin is retained; non-Bitcoin holdings belong to a distinct Digital Asset Stockpile.
claims.location: Creating a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile bullets.
claims.classification: Contemporaneous official summary; controlling detail remains EO

claims.claim: Additional Bitcoin acquisition strategies must be budget neutral without incremental taxpayer costs.
Hamilton was the first Treasury Secretary; his statue stands on Treasury's south plaza.
The Federal Register issue was published on 11 March 2025.

precision_notes: Initial reserve eligibility is narrower than all seized Bitcoin. Section 3(a) specifies finally forfeited holdings or holdings satisfying civil money penalties, excluding assets needed for statutory requirements or released under section 3(d).

Section 3(d) preserves court orders, legal requirements, victim returns and specified enforcement/distribution exceptions. The plaque is a concise reference to the reserve retention rule, not a blanket description of all government-held assets.
The separate non-Bitcoin stockpile has different stewardship rules; the order does not impose Bitcoin's same reserve-sale rule on every digital asset.
Budget-neutral strategy development is not evidence of immediate market purchases or an unlimited buying authorization.
No legal-tender, national currency, investment-return, fixed current reserve balance or current operational-status claim is made.
Uncle Sam, monumental coin and plaque are fictional visual symbols. Treasury and Hamilton provide a real location reference, not proof of an actual physical Bitcoin installation.
The removed FINALLY FORFEITED hanging tag, earlier records-room props and brief's El Salvador comparison folder are absent and not described.
Book uses the full approved v2 image. The card proof's separate 1.10 viewport crop is not applied.
